39031.rationale: All ten IDs were compared across all three seeds after reading every supplied projected field. Products, actual process distinctions, empirical versus commercial basis, exact model strings/roles, aliases for b001, measurement-column types and units are preserved. b001/b002/b007/b008 retain friction, roughness and film depth; b003/b009 retain friction and roughness only; b004/b010 retain friction only; b005 retains component inspection dimensions, edition identity and month; b006 retains commercial price and carton dimensions, never performance measurements. Text variation is meaningful: titles, clause order, paragraphing, length, presence of column lists in the main description, optional spatial text, publishers, sites and two-versus-three distribution arrangements vary, not merely a category prefix. Each distribution's entire synopsis was checked: distribution 0 consistently claims CSV/comma-separated tables, distribution 1 PDF/document tables, and optional distribution 2's CSV or PDF wording matches its format and repeats that record's documented columns/values. Verification is of metadata association, not downloaded file bytes. Strict all-facts preservation is unresolved: numeric examples and study context change, not just wording. For b001, distributions.0.description roughness/friction/film examples are 1.68/0.56/1.71 in 39031, 1.65/0.53/1.28 in 39032 and 1.41/0.57/0.68 in 39033. Its description site changes Ivy Brook Central to Elm Crossing Upper to Granite Bend Lower, with different publishers. No packet evidence states these altered values/context are interchangeable wording-only variations. Thus concept/column preservation is supported, but unchanged measured facts cannot be certified. The packet supplies intent definitions/IDs, not literal query/paraphrase texts; paraphrase equivalence and complete-corpus coverage are outside this packet review. No actual record supports either frozen no-answer conjunction. No searchable instruction, grade code or answer-key claim was observed.

39032.rationale: All ten seed-39032 records and all their projected title, description, distribution, keyword, publisher and present spatial fields were reviewed against both other versions. Measurement types, units, model strings/roles, component exclusions, b001 aliases and the commercial-ledger distinction are preserved; descriptions and titles meaningfully change structure, length, ordering and whether columns appear in the description or only distributions. Optional spatial fields and distribution counts/titles also vary. CSV/PDF format labels match their full synopses and associated columns in every distribution; no measured variable is added from an omission or negation. This is metadata-level verification, not inspection of underlying files.
